parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish اکین (ekin), from Old Anatolian Turkish اکین (ekin), from Proto-Turkic *ek-. By surface analysis, ek- (“to sow, to plant”) + -in. The meaning "culture" is a calque of French culture.
Derived from Proto-Turkic *tẹg- (whence değmek (“to touch”)) as a phono-semantic matching of French tangent. For the -et suffix, cfr. özet.
